what: A small dot (5.7px diameter) left of the button spreads a ring every 2s (radius 3 → 8px·opacity .7 → 0 linearly over the first 1s, resting for the last 1s). On hover the text is pushed 24px left over .5s cubic-bezier(.33,.01,.27,1), the dot goes out in .3s, and an arrow lights up in .3s on the opposite (right) side — as if the dot crosses over into the arrow. look: trailing keeps the dot attached to the right of the text and the text does not move

options.look: trailing — the dot attaches on the right (after the text) and the text stays in place (list ”View more” button)
options.--fx-shift: Distance the text shifts on hover, default -24px
options.--fx-fade: Duration of dots and arrows fading out and in, default .3s
options.--fx-inset: Distance of the dot and arrow from the button edge, default 20px — make the button’s left inner padding about 28px larger than this

use: Free quote
note: Original is SVG <animate> …to grow the ring — fx.js puts two circles in the dot spot and changes only the radius (r) and fill opacity with CSS keyframes, never touching the size or opacity of the button or dot elements (so the pulse does not mix into interaction measurements)

from.where: shared.js header line ”Free Quote” · every red and black button (.c-btn — dot → arrow, text -24px), list ”More” (.c-btn--trailing)
